authority.rule: Current authoritative prompt/schema override historical discussion and legacy materials.

coding_pipeline.unit: one Zenodo record at a time
coding_pipeline.stop_condition: user may stop/cancel; otherwise continue through unprocessed deposited records

critical_rules.life_stage_inference: Only Juvenile or Adult from suitable age/mass/development evidence when species-specific farmed trajectory supports it; other stages must be explicit.
critical_rules.research_question_and_objectives: Search the whole document; abstract/Introduction are not exclusive locations.
critical_rules.validation_warnings: non-fatal diagnostics unless the workflow otherwise fails
critical_rules.comparator: genuine focal comparator only; do not force survivor-versus-mortality or incidental contrasts

historical_baseline.caveat: Generated before final completeness/NOT FOUND tightening; do not use its completeness warnings as evidence that the current prompt is wrong.

resume_checklist: Review coding accuracy/completeness against full text after bulk processing
